# Zafoor Clinic

> A doctor-led skin, hair, laser, diabetes and family medicine clinic in George Town, Chennai, delivering honest, evidence-based care under the supervision of Dr. Mufeeda Roohi.

## Overview
- **Name**: Zafoor Clinic
- **Chief Physician**: Dr. Mufeeda Roohi (Founder & Chief Physician — Family Physician, Diabetologist and Aesthetic Physician)
- **Location**: 69/70, St. Xavier Street, George Town, Chennai – 600001, Tamil Nadu, India (Landmark: Opposite Huda Mosque, Broadway)

## Departments & Services

### 1. Skin, Hair and Laser (Aesthetic Medicine)
- **PRP Therapy (Platelet-Rich Plasma)**: Natural collagen induction and hair follicle revitalization.
- **GFC Therapy (Growth Factor Concentrate)**: Advanced autologous growth factor treatment for accelerated hair density and skin restoration.
- **Chemical Peels**: Medical-grade exfoliation for acne, melasma, pigmentation, and skin texture.
- **Skin Boosters**: Deep hyaluronic acid micro-hydration for natural elasticity and glow.
- **Laser Treatments**: Laser hair reduction, scar resurfacing, tattoo fading, and hyperpigmentation removal.
- **Medical Facials**: Hydra Facial and Fire & Ice clinical facial protocols.
- **Dermatology Minor Procedures**: Wart and corn removal, open pore reduction, de-tan therapy, active acne management.
- **Hair Restoration**: Scalp therapy, dandruff control, hair fall arrest.

### 2. Diabetology & Metabolic Care
- **Comprehensive Diabetes Review**: Routine glucose profiling, HbA1c review, and customized diet planning.
- **Neuropathy Screening**: Monofilament and vibration sensory nerve testing.
- **Diabetic Foot Care**: Foot ulcer prevention, specialized wound dressings, and callus care.
- **Vitals & Complication Tracking**: Systemic screening across cardiovascular, renal, and ocular risks.

### 3. Family Medicine & General Healthcare
- **Hypertension & Blood Pressure Care**: Regular monitoring and medication titration.
- **Thyroid & Cholesterol Management**: Lipid profile analysis and endocrine support.
- **Pediatrics**: General child healthcare, developmental checks, common childhood illness treatment.
- **Gynaecology**: Women's wellness, menstrual regularity, and health consultations.
- **ENT & Eye Care**: Primary diagnostic care and specialist referrals.

## Key Facts & Guidelines
- **Walk-ins & Appointments**: Walk-ins are welcomed during clinic hours (Monday – Saturday: 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM, Sunday: Holiday). Appointments can be booked in advance via WhatsApp or the website booking system.
- **Doctor Supervised**: 100% of diagnostic evaluations and procedural sessions are personally performed or supervised by Dr. Mufeeda Roohi.
- **Full Details**: For in-depth clinical procedure details, visit https://zafoorclinic.com/llms-full.txt
